objective: Add a bounded, truthful Start/resume audit to the existing Demo-only Mission Control, with current GitHub evidence, finite retries, resumable next-task selection, audit events over SSE and no public mutation.
scope: Public Start button enqueues one bounded read-only assessment using a fixed GitHub repository and endpoint allowlist.
Audit main SHA, open PRs/issues and exact-main Governance CI, choose the nearest verified open work candidate.
Show real progress, errors, retry counters, tasks and blockers through existing SSE and journal.
Apply Origin, fixed-payload, cooldown, concurrency, idempotency and fail-closed limits to the Start endpoint.
Test and deploy a free preview; do not claim perpetual running or automatic code fixes.
out_of_scope: Public code execution, remote shell, self-approval, unrestricted agent spawning, unsupervised repo mutation.
Live/Auto orders, margin changes, broker connections, KYC or asset transfers.
Unbounded retries or unsupervised spending, key issuance, G13 certification.
Pretending a read-only audit is an autonomous AI coding runner.
tests: Existing Mission Control API and agent trace suites pass.
Post-deploy public Start, SSE, /api/control and token-protected POST /api/events are verified.
security_tests: Reject cross-origin start, unknown payloads and open mutation/commands.
Finite 3 transient retries, no retries on 401/403, single active worker and 300-second cooldown.
No GitHub writes, no PydanticAI runtime claims, no broker access, no public secrets or code.
Fail closed on missing SHA, unverified CI and saturated lists.
rollback: Revert scoped additions in a fresh governed PR, roll back Render preview if validation fails.
definition_of_ready: Existing WZ-003 preview and SSE are operational.
No mutation rights added to public dashboard.
Prior contracts and GitHub-Linear canonical identity preserved.
definition_of_done: Fixed read-only Start endpoint, truthful UI and SSE working.
Exact-head CI pass; Owner and independent gates obeyed before protected merge.
Free preview is verified without financial authority.
No claim that automated bug fixes or fully independent multi-agent coding is enabled.
